evidence.quote: Here, the same harness, very important, does not mean the same agent, because the anti-gravity agent is a coding agent at the moment.

evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: An obvious trend that with better model capabilities, we can remove orchestration code, but if your harness is getting more complex as the model improves, you are most likely overengineering your harness.
